chief_complaint: Advanced chronic kidney disease (stage 4) with proteinuria, hypertension, and awaiting kidney transplantation
history_of_present_illness: The patient has a long-standing history of progressive diabetic kidney disease. Beginning in 1984 he was diagnosed with stage 1 CKD and a disorder of the kidney due to diabetes. Over the next decade he progressed through CKD stages 2, 3 and reached stage 4 by 1993. Proteinuria and microalbuminuria secondary to type 2 diabetes were documented in the late 1980s and early 1990s. He also has essential hypertension since 1969, metabolic syndrome, obesity (BMI ≥ 30), anemia, and is on insulin therapy despite a recorded prediabetes label. He is currently listed as awaiting kidney transplantation. Socially, he reports full‑time employment and unsatisfactory housing. No recent vital signs, renal function labs, or lipid panels are available.
